decisions.reason: A schlager compilation CD close to the core reissue business costs almost nothing to keep listed in a warehouse-backed catalog, and one year on the market has not resolved its sales prospects, so the option is still worth holding.

The illustrated release series builds on the label's curation strengths and the firm's aim to broaden formats, its value is still uncertain after only one year, and carrying it costs little, so keeping the option open is justified.
